reviews.review_title: Review at Chuon Chuon Quan - Chuonchuon Restaurant
reviews.review_text:
SamanthaKay1990
London, United Kingdom3 contributions
0
Surprisingly good find :)
Jan 2017 • Couples
We headed in here after originally heading to The Hanoi Social Club. Cheaper and quieter than THSC, this sweet little restaurant does both Western, Asian and local food. 
We had Hanoi spring rolls to share and then the American burgers (we were hungry), both of which were really lovely. 

The burger was huge, and came with bacon, onion fried egg and chips. The meat tasted fresh and the chips were hot. 

The kitchen was tiny, and it steadily got busier, so we were really impressed with the overall service and standard. 

The food was more expensive then eating at other local places (about £10 in total) but that includes our spring rolls and soft drinks. We would have paid a lot lot more for a lot less in other places, both here and in the U.K. It was definitely worth it in our opinion! 

There's also an outside area which looks lovely for coffee or cake during the day. We sat in side, with big comfy cushions and fresh roses on the table. Really lovely dinner!
